result.prompt: Create a whimsical storybook illustration of the ancient stone temple from the first image, preserving its exact frontal composition: the tall central weathered tower with its paired rounded peaks, three dark rectangular doorways, layered terraces, broad steps, and the two narrower towers rising at frame-left and frame-right. Render the entire scene in the style of the second image, using simplified hand-painted shapes, softly irregular ink contours, muted earthy browns, charcoal blacks, dusty blue-gray, and visible watercolor-and-gouache paper texture. Translate the temple’s carved masonry into gently uneven blocks and sparse linear details while retaining its recognizable proportions, openings, and aged surface. Replace the pale sky with a mottled blue-gray paper field scattered with tiny cream, rust, and brown speckles like drifting snow or stars. Add slender, crooked dark tree trunks and sparse bare branches around the outer edges, echoing the second image’s quiet woodland framing without obscuring the architecture. Include the second image’s small round dark-brown creature with a pale face, pointed hat, and tiny feet, standing near the lower steps and reaching upward toward a softly glowing crescent moon suspended beside the central tower. Keep the moon’s warm cream glow subtle against the cool background, with no text or modern objects.

examples.description: Place elements in a composition using bounding boxes on a 0 to 1000 grid
